nodes.title: decision.2026-10-23.judge-flashlite-nonblocking implemented in the voice runtime: judge.json timeout_ms 800 -> 1,500, model_recommended (Flash-Lite, Vertex global), mode default stays shadow. The reply never waits for the judge: a verdict in before her first sentence leaves the door acts on that reply (crisis path or opt-out confirmation); a later one settles in the background and acts from her next sentence (crisis) or turn (opt-out). Sim: a 0.3 s judge in raise mode delays the reply < 0.2 s, and its crisis raise gives the lines on her next turn; a late opt-out raise confirms on her next turn and ends opt_out; a judge that is in first still replaces the reply.

nodes.not_verified: No real model in the runtime yet. Not measured: how often the verdict lands before her first sentence on staging (Flash-Lite p95 1,126 ms vs brain first sentence). The window ends when her first sentence leaves the door, not at first audio (TTS time to first byte later), so a verdict landing in that gap acts from her next sentence. Speculative replies stay off in raise mode (cascade.judge_raises, unchanged).
